materialEvents.summary: Operator authorized a full MCP estate audit and remediation mission, elevated mode OFF, narrowest-scope governed credential use only.
Agent floated dotted MCP tool names as the root-cause theory for registration failures, based on surface correlation rather than protocol-level proof.
Operator explicitly corrected the dotted-tool-names theory, citing the MCP spec and demanding raw protocol-level proof before any renaming.
Agent built a raw MCP protocol probe, proved the baseline server already used dotted names successfully, and traced the real root cause to Claude Code's unsupported stdio cwd field.
Agent fixed the resulting tsx path-alias resolution failures with a bash -c cd-and-exec wrapper, including the leading ./ fix for --import.
Operator scoped the remaining application-level defect narrowly: fix estimator_get_knowledge_service_health via canonical ownership, do not copy the module locally.
Agent fixed Human Estimator's production-query client path to canonically reference CG-AppBuilder-MCP and committed the fix, unmerged.
Agent fixed Computer Estimator's stacked venv/dependency defect and corrected revu-mcp registry drift with a new adversarially-tested reconciliation guard, both committed and unmerged.
Agent resolved the readiness-attestation 'Token lookup failed' error (a dead local service, not a Supabase defect) and discovered the WSL validator's host-path defect.
Operator issued the FULL_CLOSEOUT_WAVERUNNER mission brief to harvest and publish this mission's intelligence through the canonical Intelligence Hub pipeline.

decisions.decision: Do not rename dotted MCP tool names
decisions.reason: The MCP specification explicitly allows '.' in tool names, and no protocol-level proof existed that Claude Code rejected a specific valid dotted name
alternativesRejected: Renaming all dotted tool names to underscore-separated names based on unproven correlation
decisions.consequences: Preserved correct tool naming across five MCP servers and forced discovery of the real root cause (unsupported cwd field) via direct protocol testing

decisions.decision: Register bid-composer-command-mcp and human-estimator-mcp via a bash -c "cd <repo> && exec node --import ./node_modules/tsx/dist/loader.mjs <script>" wrapper instead of a cwd field
decisions.reason: claude mcp add has no --cwd flag and claude mcp get never displays one, confirming the field is silently ignored by Claude Code
alternativesRejected: Continuing to rely on the cwd field
Rewriting the servers to avoid tsconfig path aliases entirely
decisions.consequences: Both servers now boot from the correct working directory and resolve @/lib path aliases correctly
decisions.authority: direct verification via claude mcp add --help and claude mcp get

decisions.decision: Fix Human Estimator's knowledge-client path using the canonical CG-AppBuilder-MCP ownership model instead of copying the module locally
decisions.reason: Operator explicitly instructed: fix the import/path using the canonical ownership model, do not copy the module into Human Estimator just to make the tool green
alternativesRejected: Copying production-query.mjs directly into CapitalGlass-BidComposer or CG-Human-Estimator-MCP
decisions.consequences: estimator_get_knowledge_service_health and its five sibling tools now resolve to a single canonical source of truth with no divergent duplicate

decisions.decision: Correct revu-mcp's lifecycleState to PLANNED_SPOKE/PLANNED in both the authority doc and discover-mcp-estate.mjs, and add an automated reconciliation guard, rather than building a stub launcher
decisions.reason: No discoverable MCP launcher exists in CapitalGlassRevu; asserting ACTIVE/REGISTERED misrepresented reality in two independent locations
alternativesRejected: Building a stub launcher to make the status appear ACTIVE without a real implementation
decisions.consequences: Authority doc and generated inventory now agree, and a new adversarially-tested reconciliation guard prevents future silent re-drift
decisions.authority: direct repository inspection of CapitalGlassRevu, adversarial self-test of the new guard

corrections.incorrectAgentClaim: Claude Code MCP registration failures are caused by dotted tool names (e.g. estimator.get_project_knowledge) being invalid or rejected
corrections.operatorCorrection: Do not rename the dotted tool names. That root-cause theory is almost certainly wrong. The MCP specification explicitly allows '.' in tool names. Only consider renaming after proving Claude rejects a specific valid dotted name in an otherwise valid tools/list -- right now we do not have that proof.
corrections.correctedTruth: The real root cause was Claude Code's stdio MCP registration having no supported cwd field; dotted tool names were valid all along and already working in the baseline server (bid-composer-app-mcp)
corrections.futureAgentRule: Never assume a naming-convention theory is the root cause of an MCP failure without protocol-level proof; test the raw initialize/tools-list sequence directly before generalizing from correlation

corrections.incorrectAgentClaim: get_mcp_readiness_attestation's 'Token lookup failed' error is a Supabase query-level defect inside requireAssistantToken.ts
corrections.operatorCorrection: A genuine Claude Code restart during the mission surfaced that the local mcp-api backend service was not running at all (ps aux / pm2 list empty)
corrections.correctedTruth: The local mcp-api service (Fastify, port 3001) simply was not running; starting it and running npm run mcp:attest produced a clean, passing attestation with no data/schema defect present
corrections.futureAgentRule: Before diagnosing an MCP control-plane data or schema defect, verify the backing service process is actually running

corrections.incorrectAgentClaim: revu-mcp is ACTIVE/REGISTERED per docs/platform-registry/mcp-authority-registry-v1.json and discover-mcp-estate.mjs
corrections.operatorCorrection: Direct repository inspection of CapitalGlassRevu found no discoverable MCP launcher matching the BidComposer pattern
corrections.correctedTruth: revu-mcp should be PLANNED_SPOKE/PLANNED; both the authority doc and the second hardcoded copy in discover-mcp-estate.mjs were corrected to match reality
corrections.futureAgentRule: Treat the authority doc as correctable, not infallible -- verify a claimed lifecycleState against real launcher files before trusting it

corrections.incorrectAgentClaim: The first version of reconcile-registry-with-authority.mjs correctly detects drift by comparing a row.source field across duplicate generated-inventory rows
corrections.operatorCorrection: Adversarial self-testing (inject a deliberately stale status, expect DRIFT_DETECTED) came back falsely RECONCILED
corrections.correctedTruth: The generator's buildEntry() never actually preserves a raw source tag on generated rows; the guard was rewritten to compare row.repository instead, which genuinely varies per duplicate row, and re-verified correct in both directions
corrections.futureAgentRule: Adversarially self-test any new drift/reconciliation guard by injecting a known-bad state before trusting it as a real safety net

durableClaims.statement: Claude Code's stdio MCP server registration has no supported cwd field as of this version (2.1.235)
tsx's tsconfig path-alias resolution depends on process.cwd() at launch time, not the script's own file location
Dotted MCP tool names are valid per the MCP spec and were never the cause of Claude Code registration failures
Human Estimator, Bid Composer Command, Bid Composer App, Computer Estimator, and Visual Asset Engine MCP servers are LIVE with real verified tool calls as of this mission
The GitHub MCP server's failure is a confirmed credential defect (Bad credentials), not a stale-process or configuration artifact -- gh CLI works independently
The Cloudflare MCP's docs path is healthy but its Workers/D1/KV/R2 operational path is a confirmed scope or authority defect, distinct from the docs path
Human Estimator's production-query implementation canonically lives in CG-AppBuilder-MCP's scripts/lib/estimating-knowledge/production-query.mjs, not a Human-Estimator-local file
get_mcp_readiness_attestation is not broken; its prior failure was a dead local mcp-api service, now resolved
validate-mcp-workspaces.mjs's WSL2 0/20 result is invalid evidence caused by a hardcoded Windows-style SYNOLOGY_OPS_ROOT path, not a real estate state finding
A new, adversarially-tested reconciliation guard (npm run mcp:workspaces:reconcile-authority) now fails closed if the generated MCP inventory diverges from the governed authority doc
All three remediation commits (0b389796, 049c439, 80a1167) are local and unmerged; none are deployed to their shared checkouts or production

mistakes.attemptedAction: Concluded that dotted MCP tool names (e.g. estimator.get_project_knowledge) were the root cause of Claude Code registration failures and began forming a rename-based fix plan
mistakes.whyItSeemedReasonable: Several newly-registered servers with dotted names were failing while some legacy servers with underscore names worked, creating an apparent correlation
mistakes.actualOutcome: The operator explicitly corrected the theory, citing the MCP spec's explicit allowance of '.' in tool names and demanding raw protocol proof; a custom probe script proved the working baseline server also used dotted names, fully disproving the theory
mistakes.rootCause: Drew a root-cause conclusion from surface-level correlation across working and failing servers instead of testing the raw MCP protocol handshake directly
mistakes.optimalFirstMove: Build the initialize -> notifications/initialized -> tools/list probe script first, before forming any naming-convention theory
mistakes.preventiveControl: Never present a root-cause theory as a finding without protocol-level or first-principles proof; test the mechanism directly before generalizing from correlation

mistakes.attemptedAction: Root-caused get_mcp_readiness_attestation's 'Token lookup failed' error purely to a Supabase query-level defect in requireAssistantToken.ts, ruling out wrong project/schema/table/column/RLS/client-config individually
mistakes.whyItSeemedReasonable: The error message and code path both pointed toward a Supabase-side query failure, and the code-level trace was internally consistent at every step examined
mistakes.actualOutcome: After a genuine restart, discovered the local mcp-api service was not running at all (ps aux / pm2 list empty) -- the entire code-level trace had been investigating a service that wasn't even executing
mistakes.rootCause: Did not verify the most basic precondition (is the backing process running) before investigating deeper application-code hypotheses
mistakes.optimalFirstMove: Run ps aux / pm2 list for the backing service before tracing application-level error-handling code
mistakes.preventiveControl: Always verify a dependent service's process is actually running before diagnosing its internal request-handling logic
